title: "Custom 2026 WAR and surplus value"
author: "Henry Blaney"
format: html

  warning: false
  message: false
---

Pipeline: Statcast PA → batting RAA + Statcast OAA (runs prevented) → replacement → WAR → FA $/win → surplus and value WAR.

Glove is **Outs Above Average**, not xBA. Savant already translates those outs into `fielding_runs_prevented` with a position-specific run value. Catchers and DH are not on this leaderboard, so they get 0 glove.

Set `rebuild <- TRUE` (or delete `data/player_war_2026.csv`) to rebuild WAR from Statcast. Otherwise salary starts from the committed CSV.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sabRmetrics)

rebuild <- !file.exists("data/player_war_2026.csv")
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("figs", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Statcast OAA

```{r}
oaa_file <- "data/oaa_2026.csv"
if (!file.exists(oaa_file)) {
  utils::download.file(
    paste0(
      "https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard/outs_above_average",
      "?type=Fielder&startYear=2026&endYear=2026&split=no",
      "&team=&range=year&min=1&pos=&roles=&viz=hide&csv=true"
    ),
    destfile = oaa_file,
    quiet = TRUE
  )
}

oaa <- readr::read_csv(oaa_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    batter_id = as.numeric(player_id),
    OAA = as.numeric(outs_above_average),
    RAA_f = as.numeric(fielding_runs_prevented),
    oaa_pos = primary_pos_formatted
  )
```

# Statcast and batting

```{r}
if (rebuild) {
  rds <- if (file.exists("statcast_2026.rds")) {
    "statcast_2026.rds"
  } else {
    "/Users/henry/Downloads/statcast_2026.rds"
  }

  if (file.exists(rds)) {
    raw_statcast2026 <- readRDS(rds)
  } else {
    n_cores <- parallelly::availableCores()
    if (n_cores >= 4) {
      cluster <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores - 2)
      raw_statcast2026 <- sabRmetrics::download_baseballsavant(
        start_date = "2026-01-01",
        end_date = "2026-12-31",
        cl = cluster
      )
      parallel::stopCluster(cluster)
    } else {
      raw_statcast2026 <- sabRmetrics::download_baseballsavant(
        start_date = "2026-01-01",
        end_date = "2026-12-31"
      )
    }
    saveRDS(raw_statcast2026, "statcast_2026.rds")
  }

  pa <- raw_statcast2026 |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(events))

  all_batters <- pa |>
    dplyr::group_by(batter_id, batter_name) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      PA = n(),
      off_runs = sum(delta_run_exp, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(PA))

  league_off_avg <- sum(all_batters$off_runs) / sum(all_batters$PA)

  all_batters <- all_batters |>
    dplyr::left_join(oaa, by = "batter_id") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      OAA = tidyr::replace_na(OAA, 0),
      RAA_f = tidyr::replace_na(RAA_f, 0),
      RAA_b = off_runs - league_off_avg * PA,
      total_raa = RAA_b + RAA_f
    )

  above_replacement <- all_batters |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 390)
  replacement_players <- all_batters |>
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = nrow(all_batters) - 390)

  replacement_avg <- sum(replacement_players$total_raa) /
    sum(replacement_players$PA)

  player_stats <- above_replacement |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      shadowRAA = PA * replacement_avg,
      WAR = (total_raa - shadowRAA) / 10
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(WAR))

  write.csv(player_stats, "data/player_war_2026.csv", row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  player_stats <- read.csv("data/player_war_2026.csv")
}

head(player_stats, 10)
```

Regulars = top 390 in PA (13 jobs × 30 teams). Catchers/DH have RAA_f = 0 because they are not on the IF/OF OAA board.

# Salaries and the FA price of a win

```{r}
salaries <- readr::read_csv(
  "data/salaries_2026.csv",
  col_select = 1:8,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(batter_id)) |>
  dplyr::select(
    batter_id, team = Team, name = Name, salary = salaries,
    service_class, extension, notes
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    salary_m = salary / 1e6,
    extension = trimws(extension),
    free_agent = service_class == "FA"
  )

dat <- player_stats |>
  dplyr::inner_join(salaries, by = "batter_id") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(salary_m))

dat |> dplyr::count(service_class)

fa <- dat |> dplyr::filter(free_agent)
rate_fit <- lm(salary_m ~ 0 + WAR, data = fa)
rate <- unname(coef(rate_fit)["WAR"])
rate
```

Value WAR = on-field WAR minus wins the contract bought at this rate.

```{r}
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    expected_salary_m = pmax(rate * WAR, 0),
    surplus_m = expected_salary_m - salary_m,
    war_over_contract = WAR - salary_m / rate
  )

cols <- c(
  "batter_name", "team", "service_class", "PA", "WAR", "salary_m",
  "expected_salary_m", "surplus_m", "war_over_contract"
)

dat |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(war_over_contract)) |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cols)) |>
  head(8)

dat |>
  dplyr::arrange(war_over_contract) |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(cols)) |>
  head(8)

dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(service_class) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_WAR = mean(WAR),
    mean_salary_m = mean(salary_m),
    mean_surplus_m = mean(surplus_m),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(dat, "data/player_value_2026.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

Ohtani is hitter WAR plus whatever OAA he has as a DH/OF. Pitching is not in this number.

# Does WAR explain salary?

```{r}
cor(fa$WAR, fa$salary_m)
summary(lm(salary_m ~ WAR, data = fa))

pal <- c(FA = "firebrick", Arb = "steelblue", "Pre-Arb" = "darkgreen")
png("figs/war_vs_salary.png", width = 2200, height = 1400, res = 180)
par(mar = c(6.2, 6.5, 4.5, 1.5), cex.lab = 2.1, cex.axis = 1.9, cex.main = 2.0)
plot(
  dat$WAR, dat$salary_m,
  pch = 16, cex = 1.35,
  col = pal[dat$service_class],
  xlab = "2026 custom WAR (OAA glove)",
  ylab = "2026 salary ($ millions)",
  main = sprintf("FA price: $%.1fM per WAR", rate)
)
abline(a = 0, b = rate, lwd = 4)
legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = c("FA", "Arb", "Pre-Arb", sprintf("$%.1fM / WAR", rate)),
  col = c(pal["FA"], pal["Arb"], pal["Pre-Arb"], "black"),
  pch = c(16, 16, 16, NA),
  lty = c(NA, NA, NA, 1),
  lwd = c(NA, NA, NA, 4),
  cex = 1.7, bty = "n", pt.cex = 1.6
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
by_class <- dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(service_class) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_surplus = mean(surplus_m),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
by_class$service_class <- factor(
  by_class$service_class,
  levels = c("Pre-Arb", "Arb", "FA")
)
by_class <- by_class[order(by_class$service_class), ]
cols_bar <- c("Pre-Arb" = "#2E7D32", Arb = "#3A6EA5", FA = "#B22222")

png("figs/surplus_by_class.png", width = 2000, height = 1400, res = 180)
par(mar = c(5.5, 7.2, 4.5, 1.2), cex.lab = 2.1, cex.axis = 1.9, cex.main = 2.0)
bp <- barplot(
  by_class$mean_surplus,
  names.arg = paste0(by_class$service_class, "\n(n=", by_class$n, ")"),
  col = cols_bar[as.character(by_class$service_class)],
  ylab = "Mean surplus ($ millions)",
  main = "Pre-arb and arb beat the FA price. FAs do not.",
  ylim = c(min(by_class$mean_surplus) - 2, max(by_class$mean_surplus) + 3)
)
abline(h = 0, lwd = 2)
text(
  bp, by_class$mean_surplus + ifelse(by_class$mean_surplus >= 0, 0.7, -0.7),
  labels = sprintf("%+.1f", by_class$mean_surplus),
  cex = 2.0, font = 2
)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
hi <- dat |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(war_over_contract)) |>
  head(6)
lo <- dat |>
  dplyr::arrange(war_over_contract) |>
  head(6)
both <- rbind(lo, hi)

png("figs/value_war.png", width = 2000, height = 1400, res = 180)
par(mar = c(5, 10, 4, 2), cex.axis = 1.2, cex.lab = 1.4, cex.main = 1.5)
barplot(
  both$war_over_contract,
  names.arg = both$batter_name,
  horiz = TRUE, las = 1,
  xlab = sprintf("Value WAR (WAR - salary / $%.1fM)", rate),
  main = "Value WAR"
)
abline(v = 0, lwd = 2)
dev.off()
```
